newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers firm, enquiries healthy.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers firm, enquiries healthy.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes were supported at firm levels on Monday over anticipations for cargo strength, traders said.
"Enquiries are quite all right today, but I don't think many shipowners will really pay high prices at this moment," said one trader, noting sufficient supplies.

Bunker 380-cst was quoted at $98-$100 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was at $103-$104, about $1-$2 per tonne higher from last week's levels. MDO and gas oil stabilised at around $198 and $210 respectively.
